title: Accordion
summary: A stack of collapsible sections; exclusive mode keeps one open.

props.name: exclusive
props.description: Opening one item closes the others.

writes.why: With exclusive, opening one item closes the others. The items raise pk-toggle for it. Not undone on disconnect.

a11y: Items are native details and summary: Enter and Space toggle, find-in-page opens matches.

examples.title: Exclusive
examples.html:
<pk-accordion exclusive>
  <pk-accordion-item heading="Shipping" open>Ships in 2 days.</pk-accordion-item>
  <pk-accordion-item heading="Returns">30 days.</pk-accordion-item>
</pk-accordion>
